app.name: Railway Freight Loader
app.description: Spin containers up and down on Railway.

footer.apiNote: Not affiliated with Railway. Container data comes from your own Railway account.

landing.intro: Spin containers up and down in your own Railway projects. Sign in with Railway and pick which projects this app may touch.
landing.consentNote: Railway’s consent screen lets you choose exactly which projects to share. This app can only destroy the services it created — the ones it names {prefix}…. Everything else in your projects is read-only here.

notFound.title: That page does not exist
notFound.description: The address may have a typo, or the link that brought you here may be out of date. Nothing was moved or deleted.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.createdHere: {managed, number} of {total, plural, one {# container} other {# containers}} created here
dashboard.listSummary: Showing {shown, number} of {matched, plural, one {# container} other {# containers}}, {managed, number} created here
dashboard.endOfList: That is every container in this environment.
dashboard.endOfFilteredList: That is every container matching these filters.
dashboard.prefixNote: Services named {prefix}… were created here and can be destroyed here. Everything else is shown for context only.
dashboard.containerTotals: {cpu} vCPU and {memory} across {count, plural, one {# container} other {# containers}} created here
dashboard.workspaceSpend: {named, select, yes {The {workspace} workspace} other {This project's workspace}} has used {amount} so far this billing period ({start} – {end}). That covers every service in the workspace, including ones this app did not create — Railway reports no per-project or per-container cost.
dashboard.workspaceSpendUnavailable: Railway reports spend per workspace, and this app cannot read it for this project. Your current usage is on Railway's own billing page.
dashboard.noProjectsDescription: Railway returned an empty project list for this account. Your authorization is intact, so re-authorizing changes nothing — create a project here and it will appear in Railway too.
dashboard.noProjectsScopeTitle: This app was not granted project access
dashboard.noProjectsScopeDescription: Railway withheld {scopes} at consent, so it reports no projects no matter how many you have. Authorizing again and approving project access will fix it.
dashboard.droppedSelection: The project in this link is no longer available, so the first one is shown instead.
dashboard.emptyDescription: Spin one up above and its build logs will stream here.
dashboard.errorDescription: This is usually a Railway API hiccup or an expired authorization. Retrying is safe — nothing was created or destroyed.

createProject.title: Create a project
createProject.description: This creates a project on your own Railway account. It is not deleted from here — projects are removed in Railway's own dashboard.
createProject.label: Project name
createProject.failedTitle: The project could not be created

createEnvironment.title: Create an environment
createEnvironment.description: A new, empty environment in this project. Nothing is copied into it and nothing is deployed, so it costs nothing until you spin something up.
createEnvironment.label: Environment name
createEnvironment.failedTitle: The environment could not be created

filters.searchPlaceholder: Filter by name, image or repo
filters.noMatchesDescription: Widen the search or clear the filters to see the rest of this environment.

containers.notManagedTooltip: Only services created in this app can be destroyed here. Manage this one on Railway.
containers.noDeployment: This service has no deployment yet, so there is nothing to stream.
containers.failedExplanation: Railway reported this deployment as failed. Its API returns the status and nothing else, so the reason — a missing image, a refused pull, a crash on the first tick — is on Railway's own page for this service.
containers.failedWithReason: Railway reported this deployment as failed at the {step} step, and said: “{reason}”
containers.failedAtStep: Railway reported this deployment as failed at the {step} step, and carried no reason with it. Its own page for this service has the rest.
containers.failedReasonOnly: Railway reported this deployment as failed, and said: “{reason}”
containers.noLogOutput: No log output for this deployment.
containers.streamUnavailable: The log stream could not be opened. Close another open log panel, or reload the page.
containers.logSearchMinChars: Type at least {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} to search.
containers.logCopied: {count, plural, one {Copied one log line} other {Copied # log lines}}
containers.logCopyFailed: The log lines could not be copied
containers.logCopyFailedDetail: The browser refused access to the clipboard. Select the lines and copy them, or download them instead.

spinUp.imageHint: Pick one, or type any public image reference. Private registries are not supported yet.
spinUp.nameHint: Prefixed automatically so this app can tell its own containers apart.
spinUp.selectProjectFirst: Select a project and environment first.
spinUp.imageNoMatches: No preset matches. Any public image reference works here.
spinUp.variablesDescription: Set what this image needs to run. A blank value on a preset row is generated for you and readable on Railway, under this service's Variables.
spinUp.variablesFull: That is the most you can set here. Add the rest on Railway.

destroy.title: Destroy {name}?
destroy.description: This permanently deletes the service and its deployment history from Railway. It cannot be undone.

actions.invalidForm: Check the form and try again.
actions.duplicateName: A container named “{name}” already exists here.
actions.spinningUpWithCredentials: Spinning up {name}. Its generated credentials are on Railway, under this service's Variables.
actions.createdButNotConfigured: Created {name}, but Railway refused its environment variables, so it was not deployed. Destroy it and try again.
actions.createdButNotDeployed: Created {name}, but Railway refused to deploy it. Destroy it and try again.
actions.notManaged: This service was not created here, so it cannot be destroyed here.

validation.imageTooLong: Keep the image reference under {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
validation.imageInvalid: That does not look like a valid image reference
validation.referenceInvalid: That reference is not one Railway could have issued. Reload the page and try again.
validation.variableNameRequired: Give this variable a name, or clear the row
validation.variableNameTooLong: Keep the name under {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
validation.variableNameInvalid: Variable names use letters, numbers and underscores, and cannot start with a number
validation.variableNameReserved: Names starting with RAILWAY_ are set by Railway itself
validation.variableNameDuplicate: This name is already set on another row
validation.variableValueTooLong: Keep the value under {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
validation.variableValueInvalid: Values cannot contain line breaks. Paste a single line, or set this one on Railway.
validation.variablesTooMany: Set at most {max, plural, one {# variable} other {# variables}} here
validation.variablesTooLarge: The variables are too large together. Keep them under {max} characters.
validation.variablesMalformed: The variables could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
validation.submissionInvalid: This form could not be submitted. Reload the page and try again.
validation.projectNameTooLong: Keep the name under {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
validation.environmentNameTooLong: Keep the name under {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again. Reference {incident}.
errors.sessionExpired: Your Railway session expired. Sign in again.
errors.projectsFailed: Could not load your Railway projects. Reference {incident}.
errors.containersFailed: Could not load containers for this environment. Reference {incident}.
errors.deploymentNotFound: That deployment no longer exists, so there is nothing to stream.
errors.streamLimit: Too many log panels are open at once. Close one and expand this row again.
errors.logsTruncated: This container is logging faster than the panel can display. Older lines were dropped; what you see is the most recent output.

api.auth: Railway rejected your credentials, so the authorization is no longer valid. Signing in again will restore it. Reference {incident}.
api.notAuthorized: Railway refused this request for your account. The authorization is live but does not cover what the app asked for, so retrying will not help — authorize again and approve access. Reference {incident}.
api.missingScope: Railway did not grant this app {scope} access, so it cannot read this. Authorize again and approve it on the consent screen. Reference {incident}.
api.rateLimitRetry: Railway's rate limit was hit. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}. Reference {incident}.
api.rateLimit: Railway's rate limit was hit. Try again shortly. Reference {incident}.
api.network: Could not reach Railway. Check your connection and retry. Reference {incident}.
api.server: Railway returned a server error. This is usually transient — retry. Reference {incident}.
api.graphqlUnexpected: Railway refused this operation for a reason the app does not recognise, so retrying is unlikely to help. The server log records what Railway said. Reference {incident}.
api.graphqlSchema: Railway rejected this query — the app asked for something the API does not offer. Reference {incident}.

signIn.session_expired: Your Railway session expired and could not be renewed. Sign in again.
signIn.no_refresh_token: Railway did not return a refresh token, so the session would expire in an hour. Sign in again and approve offline access when prompted.
signIn.token_exchange_failed: Railway rejected the sign-in. Try again — if it keeps failing, the server log records the reason.
signIn.missing_pkce_state: The sign-in attempt timed out or the cookies were cleared. Start again.
signIn.missing_id_token: Railway did not return an identity token. Try again.
